text: Why should cable labels encode location rather than purpose?
choices: Purpose changes and location does not: 'A-3-14 to B-1-07' is still correct in five years; 'Accounts printer' will be wrong within eighteen months and will actively mislead
Purpose labels are harder to print
explanation: A stale label is worse than none because it is trusted. The same principle governs documentation generally, and the fix is a review trigger tied to the change process rather than to a calendar.
